info.title: Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials
info.description: Generic create, read, update, and delete access to the Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials REST API (ADF REST), plus resource actions, ERP integration job submission, and an MCP endpoint for Copilot Studio. Works against any Financials resource collection (invoices, payablesPayments, receivablesInvoices, journalBatches, ledgerBalances, expenses, cashBankAccounts, and hundreds more). Resource, field, action, and body pickers are populated dynamically from the pod's own metadata.

get.description: Queries records from any Financials REST resource collection using the ADF query grammar (q, finder, fields, expand, orderBy, limit, offset).

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: The resource collection name, for example invoices, payablesPayments, receivablesInvoices, or journalBatches.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Row filter using the ADF query grammar, for example InvoiceNumber='INV-1001' or Supplier LIKE 'Zava%'.

parameters.name: finder
parameters.description: Named finder and its parameters, for example PrimaryKey;InvoiceId=300100012345678 or ESSJobStatusRF;requestId=12345.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of attributes to return, for example InvoiceId,InvoiceNumber,InvoiceAmount. The picker lists one attribute at a time; separate multiple with commas.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of child resources to include, for example invoiceLines,invoiceInstallments.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Sort expression, for example InvoiceDate:desc.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the first record to return (for paging).

parameters.name: totalResults
parameters.description: When true, includes the total number of matching records in the response.

parameters.name: onlyData
parameters.description: When true, omits HATEOAS links from each record.

post.description: Creates a new record in the specified Financials REST resource collection.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: The resource collection name, for example invoices.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The attributes of the record to create. The form is generated from the selected resource's metadata.

get.description: Retrieves a single record by its resource key.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: The resource collection name.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The record key (primary key value from the resource's self link), for example an invoicesUniqID.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of attributes to return.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of child resources to include.

parameters.name: onlyData
parameters.description: When true, omits HATEOAS links from the record.

patch.description: Partially updates an existing record. Include only the attributes that should change. Oracle does not cascade defaults, so review dependent attributes yourself.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: The resource collection name.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The record key.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The attributes to change. The form is generated from the selected resource's metadata.

delete.description: Deletes a record by its resource key. Not all Financials resources support delete.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: The resource collection name.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The record key.

get.description: Retrieves the child records of a parent record, for example the lines, distributions, or installments of an invoice.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: The parent resource collection name, for example invoices.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The parent record key.

parameters.name: childResource
parameters.description: The child resource name, for example invoiceLines or invoiceInstallments.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Row filter applied to the child records.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of child attributes to return.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of child records to return.

parameters.name: onlyData
parameters.description: When true, omits HATEOAS links from each child record.

get.description: Returns the metadata (attributes, actions, child resources) for a resource collection.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: The resource collection name.

Resources.description: Map of resource metadata keyed by resource name.

post.description: Invokes a custom action on a Financials resource, for example validateInvoice, cancelInvoice, applyPrepayments, calculateTax, or initiateStopPayment.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: The resource collection name that exposes the action, for example invoices.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action name, for example validateInvoice.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The action parameters. The form is generated from the selected action's metadata; when the action has no published parameters, supply the payload as raw JSON.

get.description: Searches supplier invoices in Oracle Payables by number, supplier, business unit, or a raw filter.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Row filter, for example InvoiceNumber='INV-1001' or Supplier LIKE 'Zava%' and InvoiceAmount>1000.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of attributes to return.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of child resources to include, for example invoiceLines,invoiceInstallments.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Sort expression, for example InvoiceDate:desc.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of invoices to return.

parameters.name: onlyData
parameters.description: When true, omits HATEOAS links.

post.description: Submits an ERP integration operation, most commonly an Enterprise Scheduler (ESS) job such as the Import Payables Invoices or Post Journals process. Set Operation Name to submitESSJobRequest and supply the job package, job definition, and parameters.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The ERP integration request.

201.description: The submitted request, including the ESS request identifier.

get.description: Returns the status of a submitted Enterprise Scheduler job using the ESSJobStatusRF finder.

parameters.name: finder
parameters.description: The status finder, for example ESSJobStatusRF;requestId=12345.

parameters.name: onlyData
parameters.description: When true, omits HATEOAS links.

post.summary: Invoke Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials MCP
post.description: Sends JSON-RPC 2.0 requests to the Model Context Protocol server for tool execution and capability management.
